data.name: Khabir
data.gender_notes: Khabir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘Kh-B-R’, meaning ‘to inform’, ‘to bring news’. Khabir refers to the one who is informed, the knowledgeable one, the one who knows something that others do not. The name Khabir carries the meaning “The One Informed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khabir usually hope their child will grow to embody the one informed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, knowledge, and enlightenment. The name Khabir is often given to a child who is believed to possess a great deal of knowledge and understanding, or to one who is destined to become a teacher, scholar, or leader.
data.etymology: Khabir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One Informed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khabir total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: خبير
in_arabic.meaning: الخبير هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يعلم كل شيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخبير هو من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، و يعني الذي يعلم كل شيء، كبيرا كان أم صغيرا، ظاهراً أو باطناً. ورد اسم الله الخبير في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ' (البقرة: 137). و هو اسم من أسماء الله التي تدل على علمه الشامل و اطلاعه التام على جميع الأشياء.

in_urdu.name: خبیر
in_urdu.meaning: خبیر اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، مطلب ہے ہر چیز کا جاننے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: خبیر اسلامی تقالید میں اللہ کے 99 ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ہر چیز کا جاننے والا یا سب کچھ جاننے والا۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ آیة 'وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ' (البقرة: 137). یہ نام اللہ کی علم و آگاہی کی جامعیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ख़बीर
in_hindi.meaning: ख़बीर अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, मतलब है हर चीज़ का जानने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़बीर इस्लामी परंपरा में अल्लाह के 99 नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है हर चीज़ का जानने वाला या सब कुछ जानने वाला। यह नाम कुरआन में भी उल्लेखित है, जैसे कि आयत 'وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ' (البقرة: 137)। यह नाम अल्लाह के ज्ञान और जागरूकता की व्यापकता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: خبیر
in_pashto.meaning: خبیر د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، معنی یې د هر شي پوهیږی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خبیر په اسلامي دود کې د الله 99 نومونو څخه يو دی، چې معنی یې د هر شي پوهیږی یا ټول شي پوهیږی. دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، لکه څنګه چې آیت 'وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ' (البقرة: 137). دا نوم د الله د علم او پوهې پراخوالی ښيي.

in_english.name: Khabir
in_english.meaning: Khabir is one of Allah's beautiful names, meaning the all-knowing
in_english.long_meaning: Khabir is one of the 99 names of Allah in Islamic tradition, meaning the all-knowing or the one who is aware of everything. This name is mentioned in the Quran, such as in verse 'وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ' (Al-Baqarah: 137). It signifies Allah's comprehensive knowledge and awareness of all things, seen and unseen. The name Khabir is derived from the Arabic root 'خ-ب-ر' which conveys the meaning of knowledge and information.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khabir holds significant cultural significance as an Arabic name. In the Islamic context, knowledge is highly valued and seen as a means of personal growth and social advancement. The name Khabir reflects this cultural importance of knowledge, as it denotes a person who possesses knowledge and wisdom. It is a name that resonates with the idea of being aware, informed, and knowledgeable. With this in mind, carrying the name Khabir would bring a sense of responsibility as well as admiration within a cultural context, reflecting a strong emphasis on education and intellectual pursuits.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Khabir holds deep meaning as the one who is informed, or indeed, enlightened. In the Islamic tradition, knowledge is not only crucial for our daily lives, but it also represents a path towards closeness to the divine. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) emphasized the importance of seeking knowledge, stating, “The seeking of knowledge is a duty upon every Muslim man and woman.” The spiritual significance of the name Khabir is thus closely connected to gaining knowledge and wisdom, which could be seen as a path to a deeper understanding of the world and, ultimately, of God. As one who carries the name Khabir, you may carry with you a responsibility to not only seek knowledge but to share it with others, filling them with wisdom and enlightenment.
